events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, the influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, we lost a true icon. Remembering the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: A true guitar hero, gone too soon. Remembering the incredible Jimi Hendrix, whose music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Still sounds as fresh and brilliant as it did in '69. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A powerful message that resonates just as much today.

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Game Changer
angles.copy: Remember life before this? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day to all 007 fans! What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we lost the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world went quiet for a moment. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, a true legend of rock.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution. A timeless classic.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world tragically lost John Lennon. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: John Lennon Memorial
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, a light went out too soon. Remembering John Lennon, whose peace-loving spirit and music continue to inspire.
